_comment: Metadata for the imported Bengaluru OSM street network (network_key osm_urban_v1).
This directory is reference data only. No simulation adapter is bound to it:
SimulationRunner, SumoTraCIAdapter and ClearPathSafetyGuard remain authoritative
on clearpath_demo, which is untouched. Phase 3 imports geometry for routing and
resilience scoring; wiring this network into SUMO is a later phase.
The .net.xml itself is not committed. It is ~2 MB of derived data, is ignored by
.gitignore, and is regenerated deterministically with the netconvert command in
README.md next to this file, then imported with scripts/import_road_network.py.
